Depends on collecting items; 2 hours of waiting for the backpack

The addons of the {wiki:Citizen Outfits|Citizen Outfit}, every player's basic outfit. {npc:Lubo} makes you a minotaur leather backpack if you bring him 100 {item:Minotaur Leather}, and {npc:Hanna}, in Thais, makes you the feathered hat from a {item:Legion Helmet}, chicken feathers and honeycombs. The quest also gives the achievement **Exemplary Citizen**.
Your basic starting outfit: simple, but practical. If you want to earn addons for this outfit, walk around Thais and look for citizens with a hat or a backpack.
The Citizen Outfit is available to everyone; only the addons are part of the quest.

{item:Minotaur Leather|Minotaur Leathers} drop from {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}; {item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers} from {creature:Chicken|Chickens}; {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} from {creature:Wasp|Wasps} and/or {creature:Bear|Bears}.
In Rookgaard you can do the same with {npc:Amber} (backpack) and {npc:Norma} (hat).

Go to {npc:Lubo}'s shop, on the **east** side of Thais (or to {npc:Amber} in Rookgaard). Say {key:hi}, {key:addon} (he says the backpack is not for sale), then {key:minotaur leather} and {key:yes}.

If you are not in Thais, take a boat and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s port. Lubo's shop is outside the walls, **east** of the city: walk there and back.
With the 100 {item:Minotaur Leather|Minotaur Leathers} in your inventory, go back to Lubo and say {key:hi}, {key:backpack} and {key:yes}.
Wait 2 hours and get the backpack
Wait **2 real hours** and go back to Lubo. Say {key:hi} and {key:addon}.
If you come back before the 2 hours are up, he says *"I didn't expect you to return that early. Sorry, but I'm not finished yet with your backpack."* Come back later.

Men and women go to {npc:Hanna}, in the jewellery shop in **Thais** (in Rookgaard, to {npc:Norma}). Say {key:hi}, {key:addon} and {key:yes}. The jewellery shop is inside Thais ({coord:32407,32219,7}).
Male Citizen with the feather hat
Female Citizen with the feather hat
With 1 {item:Legion Helmet}, 100 {item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers} and 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}, go back to Hanna and say {key:hi}, {key:hat} and {key:yes}.
This quest also gives the **Exemplary Citizen** achievement.
